d: Long, flowing rose-pink hair is styled with straight bangs and two high-set pigtails secured by large, magenta ribbon bows. The eyes are a sharp golden-orange shade with a confident, narrow expression, set upon a youthful face with a mature air. The build is slender, dressed in a red and black cutout outfit featuring a black mesh center and a high-collar black neck tie with a magenta accent. Signature details include three small black diamond-shaped marks centered on the forehead and black fingerless gloves with a gold ring accent on the right wrist.
